name: Joe Higashi
source: Joe is a Muay Thai champion, which comes as no surprise as he lived in Thailand for most of his life, training to snatch the title. Always raring for a fight, Joe is a hot-blooded man who isn't afraid of talking his opponents down and taunting them. Loving attention and being in the spotlight, he is loud and boisterous. Very goofy and sees himself as a prodigy. His headband is a gift from his grandmother.
